pairs.original:
MATCH (start:Account {_workspace_id: $workspace_id, acct_no: $a})
MATCH (start)-[:TRANSFER*1..2]->(a:Account {_workspace_id: $workspace_id})
WHERE a.acct_no <> $a
RETURN count(DISTINCT a) AS reachable_count, max(a.risk_tier) AS max_risk_tier
LIMIT $limit

pairs.original:
MATCH (a1:Account {_workspace_id: $workspace_id})-[:TRANSFER]-(a2:Account {_workspace_id: $workspace_id})
WHERE a1.acct_no < a2.acct_no
MATCH (owner1 {_workspace_id: $workspace_id})-[:OWN]->(a1)
WHERE owner1:Person OR owner1:Company
MATCH (owner2 {_workspace_id: $workspace_id})-[:OWN]->(a2)
WHERE (owner2:Person OR owner2:Company) AND owner1 <> owner2
// guarantee at least one direction
MATCH (owner1)-[:GUARANTEE]-(owner2)
MATCH (m:Medium {_workspace_id: $workspace_id})-[:SIGN_IN]->(a1)
MATCH (m)-[:SIGN_IN]->(a2)
RETURN a1.acct_no AS acct_no1, a2.acct_no AS acct_no2
LIMIT $limit

pairs.original:
MATCH (owner)-[:OWN]->(src:Account {_workspace_id: $workspace_id})
MATCH (src)-[t:TRANSFER]->(target:Account {_workspace_id: $workspace_id})
WHERE (t.amount IS NULL OR t.amount < 10000000)
WITH owner.id AS ownerId, target.acct_no AS targetAcct, collect(DISTINCT src.acct_no) AS srcAccounts
WITH ownerId, collect({target: targetAcct, srcCount: size(srcAccounts)}) AS transfers
WHERE size(transfers) = 1
RETURN ownerId AS owner_id, transfers[0].srcCount AS account_count
ORDER BY account_count DESC
LIMIT $limit

pairs.original:
MATCH (src:Account {_workspace_id: $workspace_id})-[:USES_CHANNEL]->(ch:Channel {_workspace_id: $workspace_id})
MATCH (src)-[:TRANSFER]->(dst:Account {_workspace_id: $workspace_id})
RETURN ch.code AS channel_code, count(*) AS tx_count
ORDER BY tx_count DESC
LIMIT $limit
